title: Program Officer
description:
WIPO Brazil Office, Regional and National Development Sector

Grade - NOC

Contract Duration - 2 years (maximum cumulative length of 5 years) *

Duty Station : BR-Rio de Janeiro

Publication Date : 12-Jan-2026 Application Deadline : 11-Feb-2026, 4:59:00 PM

IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING APPLICATION DEADLINE: please note that the deadline for applications is indicated in local time as per the time zone of the applicant's location.

This post is a limited-term fixed-term post.

1.Organizational Context

a. Organizational Setting

The post is located in the WIPO Brazil Office (WBO).

The WBO is part of a network of WIPO External Offices that add clear value, efficiency and effectiveness to the delivery of WIPO's programs, in line with its Strategic Goals and Results Framework, in a coordinated and complimentary way with WIPO Headquarters.

The WBO assists the Brazilian government, IP professionals, creators, innovators, businesses and communities in Brazil create value from IP through the use of WIPO treaties, services and global databases, platforms, tools, and products, as well as through the design and implementation of impactful projects and initiatives on the ground. The WBO also works to increase awareness on the importance of strengthening the Brazilian IP and Innovation ecosystem for economic, social and cultural development.

b. Purpose Statement

The Program Officer is responsible for providing technical guidance and supporting the development and implementation of project-based initiatives for Brazil. The Program Officer is responsible for ensuring close liaison and cooperation with the Brazilian authorities and other stakeholders in the country to extend the reach and impact of WIPO's support at the national, institutional and community level. The Program Officer also supports the Director of the WBO in ensuring the efficient and effective operations and management of the Office and its close and integrated functioning with WIPO Headquarters.

c. Reporting Lines

The Program Officer works under the supervision of the Director of the WBO.

d. Work Relations

The Program Officer liaises closely with Sectors, Divisions and work units in Headquarters, in particular with the Department of Development Cooperation and the Division for External Offices Coordination, connecting WIPO's cooperation assistance modalities, services, databases, tools, platforms and products with beneficiaries in Brazil in a coordinated, effective and efficient manner.

2.Duties and Responsibilities

The incumbent will perform the following principal duties:

a.Research and analyze specific data on how IP could support the development priorities for Brazil, identify new project opportunities, formulate and present project proposals providing technical and substantive input, and manage and monitor the administrative and operational activities of approved projects.

b.Design and implement capacity building programs and activities providing financial and technical support for such initiatives, coordinate with different sectors within the Organization and with external stakeholders and partners.

c.Engage with the Brazilian authorities and key national stakeholders (such as business associations, universities and research institutions, professional associations and representative bodies, civil society, innovators and creators) to design and implement projects and activities that address national needs across the country.

d.Liaise with United Nations institutions in Brazil on matters of common system interest to build synergies for mandate implementation.

e.Represent WIPO at national meetings and participate in missions and briefings to identify opportunities for and further mandate implementation.

f.Prepare reports and documents, including performance updated, progress on mandate implementation, financial results, as well as internal memoranda, draft agreements and other working documents to support reporting requirements.

g.Promote WIPO's strategies and plans that would ensure greater and more effective use of WIPO's Global IP services through targeted outreach to existing and potential users and establishment of partnerships.

h.Assist in the administration and management of the Office, including contributing to the monitoring of financial flows in line with organizational rules and regulations.

i.Perform other related duties as required.

3.Requirements

Education (Essential)

First-level university degree in law, economics, international relations, development studies or a related field.

Education (Desirable)

Advanced university degree in the above fields or a specialization in IP.

Experience (Essential)

At least six years' relevant professional experience in intellectual property, including copyright and creative economy.

Experience in project design and management.

Experience working with the Brazilian IP, innovation, and creative ecosystem.

Professional experience in international cooperation programs.

Language (Essential)

Excellent knowledge of written and spoken Portuguese and English.

Language (Desirable)

Knowledge of other UN language preferably Spanish.

Job Related Competencies (Essential)

Competent understanding and use of RBM frameworks in planning, monitoring, and evaluating projects and programmatic activities.

Ability to coordinate full project/program lifecycles, including administration of budget and financial resources.

Strong analytical thinking, organizational abilities, and planning skills, with a focus on effective progress tracking and reporting.

Strong digital literacy and adaptability in using a wide range of tools and platforms.

Excellent diplomatic skills and ability to work with tact and discretion.

Excellent drafting skills.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to foster and maintain effective partnerships and working relations in a multi-cultural environment and with a variety of stakeholders with sensitivity and respect for diversity.

Ability to work with limited supervision and take initiative while respecting Organizational regulations and rules.

Familiarity with IP concepts, including copyright and industrial property, and their relevance in project contexts.

Job Related Competencies (Desirable)

Good understanding of WIPO's international registration systems.

4.Organizational Competencies

  1. Communicating effectively.

  2. Showing team spirit.

  3. Demonstrating integrity.

  4. Valuing diversity.

  5. Producing results.

  6. Showing service orientation.

  7. Seeing the big picture.

  8. Seeking change and innovation.

  9. Developing yourself and others.

5.Information

Mobility:WIPO staff members are international civil servants subject to the authority of the Director General and may be assigned to any activities, office or duty station of the Organization. Accordingly, the selected candidate may be required to move from time to time to new functions and/or to another duty station.

Annual salary:

National Professional Officers (NPOs) are recruited locally in the country of the duty station. NPO shall normally be nationals of the country of the duty station.

Annual salary: BRL (Total Net)

Salaries and allowances are paid in local currency.

Please refer to WIPO's Staff Regulation and Rules for detailed information concerning salaries, benefits and allowances.

Additional Information

  • Initial fixed-term appointment of two years, renewable subject to satisfactory performance and other applicable conditions. The selected candidate's appointment will be subject to an overall term of five years in this position, with normally no possibility of renewal beyond that term. S/he may, however, apply and be considered for other positions at WIPO.

This is not applicable to WIPO staff members on fixed-term, continuing or permanent appointments, who were recruited following a competition under Staff Regulation 4.10 ("Appointment Boards").

This vacancy announcement may be used to fill other posts at the same grade with similar functions in accordance with Staff Rule 4.9.5.

The Organization reserves the right to make an appointment at a grade lower than that advertised.

title: Roaming IREG Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.
Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

This is a Lisbon-based position, and relocation will be required. Relocation support may be provided for the selected candidate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards.
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators.
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements.
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity.
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting.
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures.
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team.

Requirements


Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming).
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs.
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems.
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services).
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting.
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services.
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch.
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service.
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers.
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills.
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits


What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

  • Experiência com ferramentas de segurança: Nmap, Metasploit, Wireshark;
  • Conhecimento em Linux e Windows (movimentação lateral/pós-exploração);
  • Entendimento de frameworks de segurança (MITRE ATT&CK);
  • Conhecimento em Firewall Fortinet, VPN FortiClient e VMware vSphere;
  • Experiência com ambientes Microsoft (Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Azure AD, Active Directory);

title: Projetista de Ativações de Marca
description:
Sobre a HIKE

A HIKE é uma Creative Company que inspira e transforma pessoas e marcas através do branding, design, produção de conteúdo digital, audiovisual e ativações. Atuamos desde os primeiros passos da jornada de uma marca até a concepção de grandes projetos para gigantes globais como AMBEV, Red Bull e Unilever.

Sobre a Vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por transformar o briefing e a VT em projetos cenográficos criativos, viáveis e alinhados aos guides de marca. Na prática, é quem equilibra conceito de marca, arquitetura e execução propondo soluções inteligentes de layout, volumetria e materiais, detalhando com rigor técnico, compatibilizando marcenaria/serralheria/elétrica e garantindo que tudo o que é desenvolvido seja exequível, seguro e com padrão high-end.

Nível do Cargo

Sênior

Localidade:

Rio de Janeiro (RJ)

Principais Responsabilidades

Tradução criativa de briefing e VT:

Interpretar briefing, dados da VT e guides de marca, convertendo necessidades em soluções cenográficas com identidade, coerência estética e viabilidade construtiva.

Conceito espacial e solução criativa:

Propor ideias de layout, volumetria, fluxos, pontos de destaque e materiais que elevem a experiência e reforcem a experiência da marca, considerando restrições reais (prazo, custo, montagem, ambiente, etc).

Estudos preliminares:

Desenvolver estudos iniciais (layout, volumetria e alternativas) com rapidez e repertório, apresentando opções e racional de escolha.

Anteprojeto:

Construir anteprojetos com definições de implantação, medidas, linguagem de materiais e lógica construtiva 3D, garantindo base sólida para orçamento e validação.

Projeto executivo e detalhamento:

Produzir projetos executivos completos (plantas, cortes, elevações e detalhamento técnico), com clareza de montagem e precisão para produção.

Especificação de materiais:

Especificar materiais, acabamentos e ferragens equilibrando estética, disponibilidade, custo, durabilidade e padrão high-end.

Normas e segurança:

Aplicar normas técnicas e boas práticas de segurança/estabilidade, assegurando que a solução seja segura, montável e adequada ao ambiente.

Visitas técnicas e validação em campo:

Realizar visitas técnicas aos locais de instalação para levantamento de medidas, identificação de restrições, validação de premissas de projeto e alinhamento com produção e operação.

Requisitos

  • Experiência prévia como projetista em projetos espaciais (cenografia, live marketing, arquitetura efêmera, ativações de marca ou similares).

  • Capacidade de propor soluções criativas de espaço (layout, volumetria, materiais) sem perder viabilidade e segurança.

  • Domínio de desenho técnico e detalhamento executivo (plantas, cortes, elevações e especificações).

  • Conhecimento de materiais e processos construtivos, com olhar para acabamento e padrão high-end.

  • Boa comunicação e postura colaborativa para interface com GP, produção e fornecedores.

  • Domínio de ferramentas de projeto (Autodesk 3ds Max será um diferencial).

  • Disponibilidade para viagens e realização de visitas técnicas conforme demanda dos projetos.

Diferencial:

Experiência em projetos de tailor-made para PDVs de marcas da indústria de bebidas.

title: Legacy Manager
description:
Legacy Manager


FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION


Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women's Football Division in FIFA.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long-lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
  • Women's Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women's football landscape in Brazil and the region.
  • Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO's and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender-based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
  • Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post-tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women's Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

YOUR PROFILE


Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations:

  • Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Proven track record of working in women's football in Brazil (and the wider Region) with clear links and networks to key women's football stakeholders.

Legacy Development

  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organizing, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post-event reporting.

Communication & Stakeholder Relations:

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.

Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:

  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women's World Cup 2027


The FIFA Women's World Cup is the greatest women's sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women's football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we're looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women's football.

Fixed Term - Full Time

Nosso modelo de trabalho combina estratégia, criatividade e excelência operacional para entregar projetos culturalmente relevantes, eficientes e financeiramente sustentáveis.

Sobre a Vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável pela gestão end-to-end de projetos tailor-made para uma grande cervejaria, atuando desde o recebimento do briefing até a entrega e instalação final.

Na prática, é quem consolida e gerencia escopo, cronograma e budget, alinha expectativas com o cliente e com os times internos, coordena projetistas e produtores e garante que cada etapa do projeto seja executada dentro dos prazos, custos e padrões de qualidade definidos, mantendo as plataformas de gestão sempre atualizadas e reportando-se à liderança da operação.

Sênior

Gestão E2E de Projetos

  • Coordenar o trabalho de projetistas e produtores, internos e/ou parceiros, distribuindo demandas e acompanhando entregas.

title: Engineer, Lead Risk
description:
Performs risk & safety engineering and consulting assignments normally involving a major project or several small or less complex projects.  These projects by nature of their complexity and difficulty require the fully competent application of conventional knowledge in a particular field of engineering or science.  Independently evaluates, selects, and applies standard engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria, using judgment in making adaptations and modifications.   Assignments have clear and specific objectives, and require the investigation of variables dependent on the nature of work undertaken.

What You Will Do:

The Lead Risk Engineer will be proactive in leading projects / tasks, and obtains instructions on specific assignment objectives, complex features, and possible solutions.  Expected to work independently to source solutions for unusual problems, with support from the team, and work is reviewed for application of sound professional judgment.  Performs work that involves conventional types of risk and safety consulting work, including but not limited to: possible workshop facilitation (HAZID/HAZOP/SIL), Technical Safety Studies (Fire and Explosion, Escape Evacuation, QRA, etc.), Client facing Technical meetings, possible CFD simulation tasks.  May be assisted by Senior engineers or engineers.  May be responsible for phases of a single revenue-producing project and client interactions. 

  • Interfaces with clients to define a scope of work and job tasks.
  • Performs as a team member, technical lead or a project manager, consistent with skills and experience required for the project. 
  • Drafts technically accurate and timely reports, responses to letters, faxes, and other forms of communication.   Communication skills are continually developed – both written and oral.
  • Develops or assists in the development of qualification statements, proposals, and other presentation materials.
  • Reviews other engineers' work, and provides appropriate guidance and training when necessary.
  • Prepare and submit time charge records and expense reports in a timely manner, in accordance with Company procedures. 
  • Ensures that work products are appropriately reviewed before delivery to client.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline preferred
  • Minimum of 10 years of related work experience, or an equivalent combination of advanced education and work experience.

 Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.
  • Knowledge of related technical disciplines – specifically Risk & Safety / HSE
  • Ability to utilize basic personal computer applications including spreadsheets, word processors, email, engineering programs, and Internet browsers. 
  • Ability to identify and efficiently analyze solutions to problems. 
  • Ability to effectively communicate orally and in writing. 
  • Ability to work well with others.

Reporting Relationships:

This position reports directly to Technical Manager level or higher and has no direct reports. 

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We're at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. title: Estagiário de PCP
description:
A Dermage é sinônimo de qualidade e cuidado. Cuidado ao cuidar da pele de verdade, com ativos de alta concentração. Cuidado ao pensar e desenvolver produtos para a pele brasileira há 30 anos, criando fórmulas nas mais variadas texturas e para suas diversas necessidades.

Com criatividade, estudos e muitas pesquisas, a Dermage se tornou uma das marcas de dermocosméticos mais queridinhas das brasileiras. Seus produtos, desenvolvidos com ativos de alta eficácia e sem testes em animais, ganharam posição de destaque, com fórmulas premiadas e indicações de dermatologistas.

De uma pequena sala em Copacabana e poucas fórmulas, para mais de 200 produtos no portfólio e mais de 70 lojas no país, entre próprias e franquias, além da distribuição em farmácias e em grandes multimarcas.

VENHA FAZER PARTE DO NOSSO TIME

Nossa empresa tem como missão cuidar das pessoas, oferecendo saúde e beleza hoje e sempre.

  • Noções básicas de ERP ou ferramentas de BI.

Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Estar cursando Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas (a partir do 3º semestre);

Somos uma marca brasileira de dermocosméticos que há mais de 30 anos une saúde, ciência e beleza para cuidar da pele dos brasileiros. Com fórmulas inovadoras, seguras e eficazes, desenvolvemos produtos pensados especialmente para as necessidades da pele brasileira — tudo isso com muito carinho, tecnologia e propósito.

Aqui na Dermage, cuidamos de você em todos os sentidos: da pele ao ambiente de trabalho. Nosso time é movido por criatividade, atitude e espírito empreendedor. Acreditamos que inovar exige imaginação e ousadia, e que crescer é resultado de coragem, aprendizado constante e foco nos resultados.

Cuidamos de você — promovendo beleza e saúde com foco no bem-estar de longo prazo.

Somos apaixonados pelo que fazemos e queremos ao nosso lado pessoas que compartilhem desse mesmo brilho nos olhos. Se você busca um ambiente que valoriza a colaboração, a inovação e o desenvolvimento contínuo, vem crescer com a gente

title: Marketing Associate
description:
About DataCamp

DataCamp powers data and AI transformation. With DataCamp, individuals, teams, and organizations of any size can learn the data and AI skills they need to thrive in the 21st century. With over 17M learners and 6,000+ organizations learning daily, DataCamp is a market leader in bridging the data and AI skills gap. Whether you're fostering enterprise-wide data and AI literacy, developing core data skills, adopting generative AI, switching data warehouses, or navigating the cloud transition—DataCamp offers tailored learning programs to meet your organization's unique needs.

About you

We are looking for a Marketing Associate to fuel the growth of our core Social Impact program (DataCamp Classrooms). This is a unique hybrid role that sits at the intersection of growth marketing, partnership management, and content creation.

You will be the face of DataCamp for hundreds of educators in the USA and Europe, driving adoption through direct product demos and supporting technical integrations. Simultaneously, you will own organic growth initiatives—from link building and Reddit community management to executing press releases for top-tier partnerships. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and want to own the growth of a high-impact product, we'd love to meet you.

Responsibilities:

  • Scale Academic Partnerships: Support the acquisition and onboarding of key academic partners in the USA & Europe.
  • Drive Activation: Support onboarding via product demos, documentation building, and acting as the primary point of contact for North American teachers.
  • Manage Government & Strategic Alliances: Support the landing of high-stakes partnerships, including government bodies, LLM labs, and corporate CSR partners.
  • Own Community & Organic Growth: Drive traffic to DataCamp's Social Impact pages by managing our presence on digital forums (e.g., Reddit, Discord).
  • Execute Content & Communications: Support the creation of press releases, blog posts, newsletters, social media posts, and tutorials.
  • Maintain Onboarding Assets: Develop and refine teacher-facing resources, including welcome tutorials and support documentation to drive self-serve success.
  • Leverage automation & AI: Prototype low‑code automations (e.g., n8n or ) and use modern AI tools responsibly to standardize processes and increase efficiency.
  • SEO & Linkbuilding: Own link-building efforts with nonprofits and university partners.

Support Experimentation: Proactively identify opportunities for improvement at all stages of the marketing funnel. Formulate hypotheses, execute tests, and iterate on solutions to drive continuous optimization of key metrics.

Qualifications:

  • Fluent in English
  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, social sciences, or related fields.
  • 1-3 years of experience with go-to-market initiatives .
  • Comfortable conducting live demos and presenting to educators and administrators.
  • Experience engaging with communities on Reddit, Discord, or similar forums.
  • Data-driven with the ability to track your own metrics and report on them.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage a high volume of operational tasks alongside strategic projects.
  • Bonus: You will be working with a lot of US universities so experience with these is an added bonus
  • Bonus: Experience with content writing, video editing, or visual design.

Why Datacamp?

Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you'll love being on our team:

  • Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding.
  • Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits.
  • Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible
  • Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth.
  • Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit.
  • Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup.
  • Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we're awesome

Se você sonha em trabalhar transformando vidas e reescrevendo histórias, seu lugar é no Pensi.

  • Curso de Reanimação Cardiopulmonar (BLS).

Atividades:


. Realizar todas as atividades mantendo o alinhamento às premissas de saúde, segurança e meio ambiente.

. Assistencia ao paciente, prestando cuidados diretos em todas as fases do perioperatorio, sob supervisão do enfermeiro, conferir identificação do paciente, tipo de cirurgia e lateralidade conforme protocolo de segurança cirurgica

. Preparo do ambiente cirurgico, realizar a montagem e desmontagem de sala cirurgica, conforme tipo de procedimento e tecnica asseptica, conferir o funcionamento de equipamentos o suprimento de materias e intrumentais necessarios para cirurgias.

. Atuar como circulante de sala, matendo a assepsia, fornecendo instrumentais e materias a equipe esteril, prestar auxilio ao intrumentador e ao enfermeiro durante o ato cirurgico.

. Manter controle de compressas, intrumentais e materias utilizados, conforme protocolo de contagem cirurgica, zelar pelo correto acondicionamento e envio de peças anatomicas para exame anatomopatologica.

. Execultar a limpeza e o encaminhamento de materias e intrumentais para o Centro de materias e esterilização (CME). Verificar o funciomento e conservação de equipamento medico-hospitalares, comunicando irregularidades.

.Controlar o consumo e reposição de materias e medicamentos de uso rotineiro no centro cirurgico, cumprir rigorosamente as normas de biossegurança, controle de infecção e precauções padrão.

. Colaborar na identificação e notificação de intecorrencias e eventos adversos, aplicar praticas seguras para prevenção de acidentes ocupacionais e infecções realacionadas a assistencia a saude (IRAS).

.Manter comunicação efetiva com a equipe multidiciplinal e seguir orientações de enfermeiro resposável, participar de treinamentos, capacitações e atualizações sobre tecnicas cirurgicas e protocolos institucionais.

. Contribuir para a melhoria continua dos processos de enfermagem no centro cirurgico.

title: Intern/Mechanical Engineer
description:
ABS Interns are integrated into ABS business operations and will experience various aspects of engineering review, technical problem solving, and/or research and development. Interns will work with a designated advisor to learn and develop skills relating to ABS's core business functions while also assisting ABS with key deliverables. It is expected that interns will be assigned multiple projects for their respective departments throughout the course of their internship. 

What You Will Do:

  • The primary function of an intern is to develop skills and knowledge of ABS core business functions including but not limited to:
    • Engineering Plan Review.
    • Technical Plan Review.
    • Research and Product Development.
    • Operational Safety and Evaluation.
    • Data Science and Digital Services
  • Interns may provide engineering support in the form of design review and analysis assignments typically involving a major project or several smaller, less complex projects. Projects will vary in complexity and difficulty.
  • Under the supervision of an experienced engineer or engineering manager, interns may assist with a detailed engineering review of plans as assigned for compliance with applicable Rules, Regulations, and contract commitments.
  • Communicate the status of the current workload to all appropriate members of the team to ensure that the needs of the clients will be met.
  • May propose technical advice to field operations and other technical offices.
  • May propose new approaches to problems encountered and make recommendations for changes in methods, procedures, or designs.
  • May assist in the development of business performance metrics including the development and implementation of an ongoing business performance monitoring program, and the periodic analysis of operating results to determine causes, trends, etc.
  • May assist with the writing and presentation of technical papers and reports concerning areas of expertise and work performed.
  • May assist with Rule development projects as assigned.
  • Interns may collaborate with the digital team and with other departments such as services, class, project management, commercial operations, etc.
  • Intern may assist with data collection efforts for data quality improvement, in both existing and new data streams to support overall business goals.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Applicants must be working towards an engineering degree at an accredited school and have completed 50 semester hours towards that degree before the start of the internship.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Basic engineering knowledge and proficiency in Excel and AutoCAD are preferred.
  • Must be a full-time student currently enrolled in an accredited university and pursuing a BS, MS, or Ph.D. degree in one of the following engineering discipline:
    • Mechanical Engineering 

Reporting Relationships:

This position does not have any direct reports.

title: UGC Coordinators
description:
We are inBeat, a leading creative growth agency that partners with world-class brands like Bumble, Miro, and Nordstrom. We blend data-driven paid media with authentic influencer and User-Generated Content (UGC) marketing to deliver measurable results.

We are looking for a highly skilled and experienced UGC Creator Manager to join our remote team. Our business is growing rapidly, and we need an expert who can help us scale our network of high-performing UGC creators.

This is not just about finding people to make videos. We need a strategic operator who understands the creator economy inside and out. You will be responsible for the entire creator pipeline: from sourcing and vetting niche talent to negotiating rates and managing relationships to ensure a steady flow of top-quality, on-brand content for our clients.

Your Responsibilities Will Include:

  • Proactively sourcing and recruiting high-quality UGC creators across various platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, etc.).

  • Building and maintaining a meticulously organized database of vetted creators, tagged by niche, skills, and performance history.

  • Managing the end-to-end casting process for client campaigns, including briefing creators and ensuring content aligns with brand guidelines.

  • Negotiating rates and usage rights with creators to ensure fair compensation and clear deliverables.

  • Developing and implementing innovative strategies for finding "hard-to-cast" creators in niche demographics.

  • Collaborating with our internal team of creative strategists and project managers.

Who We're Looking For:

  • You have a proven track record (2+ years) as a UGC Manager, Influencer Coordinator, or Talent Manager, preferably in an agency setting.

  • You are a master sourcer who knows how to find authentic creators that aren't on every other brand's roster.

  • You are a savvy negotiator who can secure great rates and build long-term partnerships.

  • You are obsessively organized and comfortable using tools like Airtable, Notion, or other CRMs to manage a large volume of talent.

  • You have a keen eye for what makes content compelling and perform well on social media.

title: Delivery Operations Analyst
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You'll Work With


The Data Ops team is focused on delivering high-quality, auditable data to our customers. You will work within a team dedicated to reducing customer effort and empowering clients to take actionable insights from their private markets data.

The Problems You'll Solve


As a Data Ops Analyst, you will be responsible for the lifecycle of quarterly data extraction and client reporting. Your primary objective is to ensure that extracted data is high-quality, timely, and actionable for our customers.

Your core responsibilities will include:

  • Quarterly Data Extraction: Manage the extraction of private markets data from accounting documents and performance reports.

title: Estagiário Serviços Costeiros e Oceânicos
description:

Somos uma das principais empresas de serviços profissionais do mundo, unindo nossa experiência em engenharia, consultoria e ciência para causar um impacto positivo.

Contamos com colaboradores em mais de 500 escritórios em todo o mundo e cobrimos uma ampla gama de serviços: Mineração, Transporte e Infraestrutura, Property & Buildings, Meio Ambiente, Energia e Recursos, Petróleo e Gás e Transição Energética.

Na WSP, você encontrará o espaço de que precisa para pensar grande e construir a carreira certa para você.

Nossa visão é nos tornarmos líder indiscutível do setor, moldando ambientes para o futuro das pessoas que os utilizam.

Temos orgulho do que fazemos e estamos comprometidos em causar um impacto positivo.

Somos colaborativos e inclusivos. Todos trazem algo único para a WSP e valorizamos isso - queremos incentivar a curiosidade, as novas ideias e a inovação.

Pronto para começar?

Com a gente, você pode.

A WSP Brasil está iniciando uma busca por Estagiário para atuar em nosso núcleo de Serviços Costeiros e Oceânicos, no escritório do Rio de Janeiro.

title: Implementations Lead
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve


As the Rio Implementations Lead, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and local team leadership. You will become an expert in private markets data and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta LPPA software, setting them up for long-term success.

As a technical specialist, you will: Directly interact with clients, managing implementation projects from post-sale requirements gathering to final system setup.

  • Extract the first tranches of data from documents and hand them off to the LPPA MDS team or the clients directly.
  • Train clients remotely over video conferencing and answer technical questions regarding LPPA software and setup via email or quick calls.
  • Establish strong customer relationships as the first post-sale service provider, inspiring long-term loyalty through a smooth onboarding process.
  • Work comfortably with data and business systems to develop training content for customers.
  • Think creatively to find software solutions for both equity and user problems.

As the local lead and future manager, you will be responsible for HR-based initiatives, including:

  • Overseeing onboarding, learning, and development for the local team.
  • Encouraging career growth and performance from both a professional and metrics-driven perspective.
  • Reviewing team and individual performance metrics to provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Leading the execution of strategic initiatives, such as new processes, systems, and tools across the local department.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally to identify customer pain points and provide product improvement recommendations to ensure a "magical" customer experience.

The Team You'll Join


You will be the first service provider post-sale, joining a high-growth environment where you will eventually lead a team of Support Analysts and Specialists. You will work closely with product, engineering, and internal implementations leaders to constantly improve the onboarding experience and service models for new customer types.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate complex concepts clearly.
  • Organization: Highly organized with extreme attention to detail, capable of balancing multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client-Centric: You care deeply about client services and exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise when communicating with customers under pressure.

title: Betting Content Support Specialist
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Betting Content Support Specialist. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring the accuracy and smooth operation of our betting features, identifying and resolving issues, and providing actionable insights to enhance the user experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze bugs, maintain high-quality betting content, analyze trends and metrics to support data-driven decision-making, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our app.

Requirements:

Strong passion for sports and familiarity with betting platforms and terminology.

  • Strong familiarity with the sports betting world is required – including understanding odds, expected value, and key sports trends. Personal or professional experience in betting is a significant advantage.
  • Excellent logical and analytical skills for troubleshooting and resolving issues effectively.
  • High proficiency with Google Sheets or Excel, including formulas, lookups, conditional logic, and pivot tables.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key performance indicators (KPIs) and basic ROI or accuracy metrics.
  • Detail-oriented with the ability to spot errors or inconsistencies in betting data.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, ensuring the accuracy of betting-related content.
  • Proficient verbal and written communication skills in English to clearly report findings and collaborate effectively.
  • Creative problem solver with a proactive approach to finding solutions.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication skills for reporting findings and collaborating across teams.

As a plus:

Experience in technical support, QA, or similar roles in the sports or betting industry is a plus.

Familiarity with tools and methodologies for issue tracking and bug reporting (e.g., Jira).

Basic understanding of data flows in apps or backend systems is an advantage.

Experience working in a data-focused role within the international betting industry.

Experience contributing to or implementing data-driven improvements.

Experience building reports, automations, or analytical dashboards using spreadsheets or similar tools.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and ensure the accuracy of betting-related content and features within the app.
  • Identify, report, and document bugs or issues related to betting functionality.
  • Analyze betting-related issues to understand root causes and propose actionable solutions.
  • Use analytical tools (primarily Google Sheets/Excel) to calculate metrics, validate data accuracy, and measure content or feature performance.
  • Apply logical and quantitative analysis to identify patterns, errors, and optimization opportunities.
  • Coordinate the planning, execution, and completion of tasks and projects related to betting within the scores app.
  • Validate fixes and updates to ensure they align with expected results.
  • Follow trends and updates in sports betting to provide insights for feature improvements.
  • Maintain clear communication with other team members on betting-related updates and progress.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to support team members to ensure a high level of service.
  • Stay up-to-date on industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging technologies related to sports betting.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Experiência em construção de dashboards e estudos de dados

Como é o ambiente de trabalho?
Na DPSP (lojas, CDs e corporativo), nosso trabalho impacta a saúde e o bem-estar de milhões de brasileiros todos os dias. Nossa força está nas pessoas que colocam saúde em primeiro lugar, atuam com ética, colaboração e respeito às diferenças. Junte-se a nós e seja protagonista na transformação da jornada de saúde de quem confia na gente.

Mais do que igualdade, buscamos equidade: Aqui, temos espaço para sermos autênticos, independentemente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, credo ou deficiência. Destacamos que todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PCD). #VemSerDPSP

  • Experiência prévia com gestão de equipes ou processos;
  • Ter 18 anos ou mais;
  • Ensino superior completo ou cursando;
  • Ser uma pessoa colaborativa, com boa comunicação e habilidade para se relacionar com a equipe e diferentes áreas da empresa;
  • Ter foco total no cliente, buscando compreender sua jornada e entregar uma experiência personalizada e encantadora;
